what_this_is: THE THREE PUBLISHED ADDRESSES, AND ONLY THOSE (R-2026-09-24-88 BP-10; R-2026-09-24-89 BQ-1). Every page, document and test that states an openbed.ng address reads it from here or is tested against it (tests/compliance/contacts.test.ts): no other openbed.ng address may appear in the tracked tree outside Sprint Kickoffs/ and docs/handoff*, and there is no privacy@. The operator's sign-in address is a fourth, UNPUBLISHED, address and is deliberately NOT here: it is never written into this repository (BQ-1). This file REPLACED packages/origins/ward-support.json in PR 3.4b-app B (R-2026-09-24-93 BU-2 b), whose text is kept below on the support entry.

security.purpose: Vulnerability disclosure. SECURITY.md names it, and tests/compliance/contacts.test.ts holds SECURITY.md to this value.

support.purpose: THE ONE ADDRESS A WARD IS TOLD TO WRITE TO FOR HELP (R-2026-09-23-67 B1). Every ward-console message that sends a ward to OpenBed for help names this address, read from here. tests/compliance/ward_support_contact.test.ts refuses a console message that points a ward at the operator without it.
support.ruling: R-2026-09-23-67 B1, B2. The address is the founder's: created in Proton on the openbed.ng account on 2026-09-23 and confirmed by a test email from an outside address (the founder's reading); openbed.ng's MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC read as Proton's over DNS-over-HTTPS the same day (Cowork's reading).
support.what_may_never_go_here: security@openbed.ng (vulnerability disclosure, SECURITY.md) or hello@openbed.ng (general enquiries). A ward in trouble must reach the mailbox that handles wards. A personal address, ever: support is a role, and a person leaves.
support.not_yet: A staffed phone or WhatsApp line for wards, with honest hours, is an open item before facility one (R-2026-09-23-67 B3). Until it exists, email is the only contact this console names.
